title: system.control.reload_module Output
description: Single-module and bulk reload results, and the Rust configuration-only reload result.

module_id.description: Canonical ID for a single-module reload. Null for bulk and configuration-only reloads.

previous_version.description: Version string before reload, or null if unversioned.

new_version.description: Version string after reload, or null if unversioned.

reload_duration_ms.description: Time taken for the reload operation in milliseconds.

reloaded_modules.description: Module IDs reloaded in bulk mode. An empty array means no modules matched.

config_reloaded.description: Whether the Rust SDK reloaded its configuration.

module_id.description: Canonical ID of the single reloaded module.
Bulk reload has no single module ID.
Configuration-only reload has no module ID.
